oracle_attempts.reason: Uniform explicit high-precision nlminb controls with independent stationary-score Newton polish. Fourteen previously observed local optima use documented, independently R-confirmed public starts from oracle/stage2_overrides.json. Beta endpoints are projected to open support where needed. Original input and observation retained.
